title: Commit message validation
responsibility: Cleans a hook message as Git would and reports stored-message prefix and length violations.

inputs.name: writtenMessage.file
inputs.description: Message-file contents supplied to a commit-msg hook, not a filesystem path.

inputs.name: writtenMessage.options
inputs.description: Optional Git cleanup mode and comment marker; defaults to strip and #. Verbatim preserves internal text; whitespace and scissors keep comment lines.

inputs.name: commitMessage.message
inputs.description: Commit message as stored, whose first line is the subject and remaining text is the body including trailers.

outputs.name: commitPrefixes
outputs.description: The allowed subject prefixes feat:, fix:, chore: and cleanup:.

outputs.name: writtenMessage
outputs.description: Cleaned message text: trimmed ends, configured comment and whitespace cleanup, and scissors removal in non-verbatim modes. No file is read or written.

outputs.name: commitMessage
outputs.description: Problem messages for an empty subject, a subject over 72 characters, a missing allowed prefix followed by a space and content, or a body over 60 words or 400 characters. An empty array means all checks pass; counts trim ends and normalize line endings.
